edition.en: Text from Chinese Wikisource, transcribed from volume 1 of the Complete Works of Lu Xun (1948 printing); written 24 January 1925, first published in Threads of Talk (語絲) and collected in Wild Grass (野草), 1927.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，录自《鲁迅全集》第一卷（1948 年印本）；作于 1925 年 1 月 24 日，初刊于《语丝》，收入《野草》（1927）。

basis.en: First published in 1925; the author died in 1936. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1925 年首次发表，作者卒于 1936 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: Lu Xun remembers breaking the half-finished kite his sickly younger brother had been making in secret, and, many years later, trying to ask his forgiveness, only to find that the brother has forgotten it entirely. It is here because it is an honest account of a wrong that cannot be repaired, written without self-pity. Notice the sentence ‘play is the most proper activity of a child, and toys are a child’s angels’, which he says he had to learn from a book.
note.zh: 鲁迅回忆自己折断了多病的小兄弟偷偷做的风筝，多年以后想求他宽恕，兄弟却全然忘却了。收在这里，是因为它诚实地写了一件无法补救的过错，而没有自怜。留意“游戏是儿童最正当的行为，玩具是儿童的天使”一句，他说这是从一本书里才知道的。

excerpt.orig: 我也知道補過的方法的：送他風箏，贊成他放，勸他放，我和他一同放。
excerpt.en: I knew a way to make amends: give him a kite, approve of his flying it, urge him to fly it, fly it with him.
excerpt.zh: 我也知道补过的方法的：送他风筝，赞成他放，劝他放，我和他一同放。

gloss.en: The second month of the old lunar calendar, about March, when the spring winds come.
gloss.zh: 春二月：农历二月，约当公历三月。

gloss.en: 風輪: a little wind-wheel of bamboo and paper fixed to a kite, which spins and hums in the wind.
gloss.zh: 风轮：装在风筝上的小轮子，用竹片和纸做成，迎风转动，沙沙作响。

gloss.en: The tile kite: the simplest kind, a flat oblong of paper on a bamboo frame, shaped like a roof tile, with no wind-wheel.
gloss.zh: 瓦片风筝：最简单的一种，长方形，像一片瓦，没有风轮。

gloss.en: 山桃: the wild mountain peach, among the first trees to flower in spring.
gloss.zh: 山桃：野生的桃树，开花比一般桃树早。

gloss.en: The younger brother is usually identified as Zhou Jianren (1888–1984), the youngest of the three Zhou brothers.
gloss.zh: 小兄弟：一般认为指鲁迅的三弟周建人（1888–1984）。

gloss.en: 肅殺: the harsh, withering air of late autumn and winter, an old literary phrase.
gloss.zh: 肃杀：形容秋冬天气严寒、草木凋零。

gloss.en: 胡塗: the same as 糊塗, muddled, foolish.
